column1: 1. "Feel Good Healthcare" has ~0 monthly searches in Australia. It works as a brand tagline but not as an SEO keyword.
2. "Alternative healthcare" and related terms have 4,500+ monthly searches — this is what patients actually type into Google.
3. Every major competitor (Alternaleaf, Polln, Easykind) uses "alternative healthcare" as their primary SEO keyword.
4. Our proposed changes keep HelloMello™ branding intact while targeting keywords with real search volume.
5. All updated copy is TGA-compliant: no therapeutic claims, accurate practitioner language, factual and verifiable statements only.
6. Recommendation: Use "Feel Good Healthcare" in brand materials, social media, and on-site hero sections. Use "Alternative Healthcare" in meta tags, page titles, and SEO content.
